definitions.explanation: A building for dwelling; one's residence.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きい{家|いえ}に{住|す}んでいます。
examples.english: I live in a big house.

examples.japanese: {家|いえ}で{勉強|べんきょう}します。
{友達|ともだち}の{家|いえ}に{遊|あそ}びに{行|い}きました。
examples.english: I went to my friend's house to hang out.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}、{新|あたら}しい{家|いえ}を{買|か}いたいと{思|おも}っていますが、{今|いま}はお{金|かね}がありません。
examples.english: I want to buy a new house next year, but I don't have money right now.

notes:
{家|いえ} refers to a house (building) and home (place where one lives).

READINGS:
- {家|いえ}: house, home (standard reading)
- うち: home, my house (more colloquial, can also mean "my family/company")

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {家|いえ}に{帰|かえ}る: to go home
- {家|いえ}を{建|た}てる: to build a house
- {家|いえ}を{買|か}う: to buy a house
- {家|いえ}で{仕事|しごと}をする: to work from home

COMPOUNDS:
- {家賃|やちん}: rent
- {家族|かぞく}: family
- {家事|かじ}: housework
- {家庭|かてい}: household, home

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {住宅|じゅうたく}: residence, housing (formal)
- {自宅|じたく}: one's own home (formal)
- マンション: apartment building
